hypothesis: The ~67ms chat->agents leg remaining after #2893 is the enhanced_keys drain_bounded fixed 50ms DRAIN_IDLE poll window (TS drainInput(1000,50) parity), paid on every in-process handoff. The window guards a kitty release landing after RAW MODE IS OFF (the parent-shell leak over slow SSH); on a handoff raw mode stays on and every surface's dispatch drops release events (input::filter_enhanced_key_events, TS tui.ts), so the guarded leak is unreachable on this path and the fixed wait is removable without observable behavior change: consume what the terminal has already written with zero-timeout polls, return on observed-empty, and fall through to the exact bounded idle loop only when input WAS observed.
approach: Decompose-first: instrumented throwaway BASE build (drain_instr_note to /root/drain-instr.log) observed 12/12 handoff drains consume the FULL 50ms with ZERO input events. Candidate: drain_for_handoff in enhanced_keys.rs (identical preamble: kitty pop + modifyOtherKeys reset, active check; then poll(ZERO) consume loop bounded by DRAIN_MAX; only if input observed, the original drain_until_idle(50ms idle / 1000ms cap)) + the finish() call site picks it for preserve_alt_screen only. True exits (drain, drain_for_exit) untouched. NEW real-pty e2e (pa-cli/tests/kitty_release_handoff_e2e.rs): answers the kitty probe over a raw pty (arm proof via the >7u push), injects the handoff trigger's release in flight, asserts the view mounts, late releases produce zero output, search stays interactive, exit restores with the last kitty-mode byte a pop and no post-restore echo. Evidence: same-VM sequential ABBA at the pre-fold boundary (B,C,C,B,B,C x5 x2 REAL fixtures: 2.4KB real-small + 5,103,230B real-compacted-orc) + a second pair at the FOLDED head (B,C,C,B x5 x2), sha-asserted atomic swaps (launcher + payload both asserted), per-trial driver validity flags, loadavg pre/mid/post, dual-class I/O probes + the fleet v0.9 isolated-op preflight (H/M/D) gating the final-head legs. Gates fmt+clippy+full cargo-test --workspace on BOTH arms at BOTH boundaries with full logs + isolation triage of the single cand-only red.
parity_notes: TS parity: TS Terminal.drainInput(maxMs=1000, idleMs=50) has the SAME ~50ms floor (its loop always sleeps min(idleMs,timeLeft) once before the >=idleMs check can trip) and TS returnToAgentsView->teardownSessionUi->drainInput(1000) pays it on the same leg - this is a deliberate LATENCY-only divergence. Behavior preservation: (1) a handoff keeps raw mode on (the adopting surface's reader takes the same tty; the parent shell never sees it); (2) every surface's dispatch drops release events (input.rs filter_enhanced_key_events - TS tui.ts semantics), so a release that outruns the drain is consumed-and-ignored by the next reader; (3) the port's sibling handoff direction (agents_view.rs finish preserve=true) has NO drain at all, matching TS agents-view finish. Headless unchanged by construction (identical preamble on pipes). True exits keep the TS drainInput contract byte-for-byte. Disclosure: keys typed in the teardown gap used to be swallowed within the 50ms window and can now reach the adopting surface once the drain returns early - the window was already timing-dependent (input in [50,67]ms reached the view before; the dying-reader handoff still eats near-simultaneous keys) and the adopting surface drops releases; the eat-window narrows. pty byte-count parity exact across arms (both fixtures, both pairs).
